report: Fulminant chest tightness/respiratory distress/cardiac arrest with Sjogren's syndrome and ECMO/IABP support points to autoimmune fulminant myocarditis. Endomyocardial biopsy showing diffuse monocytes and multinucleated giant cells with necrosis and fibrosis is pathognomonic for giant cell myocarditis. Elevated troponin and normal coronary arteries support it; severe global hypokinesis (LVEF~10%) fits. ACS and PE are refuted; non-ischemic cardiomyopathy is only a broad label. Final diagnosis: giant cell myocarditis.
